title: Establish consensus lanes for PRD scope clarification and sign-off
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: create a lightweight, reproducible cross-team sign-off process for PRD scope clarifications and incremental scope changes that affect API contracts, console UX, and data residency. This ticket captures the acceptance lanes (engineering, design, legal/compliance), a minimal checklist for each lane, rollout gating rules, and owner handoffs for the Structured Output PRD delta. Goal is to avoid last-minute blockers during canary rollouts and establish explicit rollback triggers and telemetry thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Engineering accepts updated API contract with backward-compatible v2 toggles documented and sample SDK calls in SDK repo
Design delivers final UI and state diagrams for feature flags, canary controls, and error states; annotated Figma with component variant tokens
Legal signs off on data residency and logging policy for the feature; list of required DPA changes and audit log events confirmed
Observability owners provide a dashboard with token-level cost delta, latency p50/p95, error rate, and prompt-set regression test pass/fail
Rollout plan defines canary cohort sizes, automatic rollback thresholds (latency + error + quality regression), and manual approval gates
Integration smoke tests (end-to-end) pass in staging with pinned model versions and no >5% throughput regression under representative load
Rollback playbook documented with owner on-call and estimated RTO/RPO
All artifact links (PRD, design spec, API doc, SDK sample, legal memo) are present in Confluence and referenced in the acceptance checklist

notes_for_reviewers: Please focus reviews on the minimal acceptance checklist: (1) is the API compatibility approach acceptable to your team, (2) are the telemetry thresholds reasonable, and (3) do we have sufficient rollback controls documented. Bring any concerns to the 2026-03-15 alignment meeting with concrete alternatives.
handshake_protocol: PM publishes pre-read 48h before meeting (Confluence + attachments)
Engineering provides an implementation note and perf estimate 24h before meeting
Design confirms Figma link and final copy 24h before meeting
Legal issues list of required contract/memo updates 24h before meeting
During meeting owners mark lanes as: Accept / Accept with minor changes / Block (requires action item)
After meeting PM to convert action items into tickets with owners and due dates within 48h
escalation_path: If any lane is Block: schedule an adjacency deep-dive within 48h and escalate to Head of Product (Rachel) if unresolved in 72h
If telemetry during canary crosses rollback thresholds automatically, on-call eng executes rollback and notifies PM, Design, Legal within 15 minutes
For legal/contract changes that require customer notice, CS and Sales must be looped within 48h
